notes: Single editable source for scientific parameters. Values follow docs/CONTRATO_CIENTIFICO.md. No credentials here.

aoi.label: Study window (provisional bbox, not the municipal boundary)

processing.threshold_note: Exploratory radar threshold. candidate if delta_db <= -threshold_db. Not a forest-loss threshold.
processing.multilook_note: Primary product: LINEAR power averaged over non-overlapping multilook_px x multilook_px blocks (10 px = 100 m at 10 m posting) using pixels valid in both dates, to reduce speckle (native 10 m differences are speckle-dominated). A cell is valid if >= 90% of its pixels are valid in both dates: strict enough that cells are mostly real data, tolerant of AOI-edge and swath-edge cells. Native 10 m metrics are kept only as diagnostics.
processing.mask_rule: valid if mask in 1..254 (subswath number of a fully focused averaging ensemble); 0 = invalid; 255 = fill. Source: NISAR GCOV product specification as summarized by ASF docs and file attributes; see processing-log for the attributes read from the file.

traffic_light.note: Experimental team cut points for TP (vegetation cover loss, %). Applied only to real TP; not evaluated for radar-only candidates.
